svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt FSNY logo, v5
svg.desc: A gently tilted mint FSNY variant. Both point-and-hole motifs remain exact geometric twins and rotate together with the lettering in one composed identity. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
